comment: Both the first and retried 'annotate' calls come back as a Claude safety-classifier refusal (stop_reason: refusal), simulating a probable biosecurity guardrail decline. The wrangler should surface the classifier's stated category/explanation to the uploader instead of a generic 'could not reach the Claude API' message.
expected_technical_error_regex: First attempt error:.*declined.*category: bio.*Second attempt error:.*declined.*category: bio
expected_user_error_regex: safety classifier declined to process your sample metadata \(category: bio\)
